name: Accordion – Organize Content into Clean Collapsible Sections
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn long, cluttered pages into clean, collapsible sections your visitors can scan in seconds – no code required.

Accordion | Pricing | Support | Live Demo

Why Accordion?

Walls of text push visitors away. B Accordion lets you organize FAQs, toggle content, feature lists, timelines, and page sections into tidy panels that expand only when a visitor wants the details – keeping your pages short, focused, and easy to navigate.

Built specifically for the WordPress block editor, the plugin focuses on ease of use, performance, and flexibility. Add unlimited accordion blocks, switch between vertical and horizontal layouts, pick a theme, and fine-tune colors and fonts – all from the block sidebar, with a smooth experience on every device.

Free Features

  • Gutenberg Block Support: A dedicated accordion block that lets you add and manage collapsible content visually.
  • 3 Free Accordion Themes: Clean, minimalist themes suitable for FAQ sections, documentation, and general content organization.
  • Vertical and Horizontal Layouts: Choose how accordion panels are displayed to match your page structure and content flow.
  • Fully Responsive Design: Accordion layouts adapt smoothly to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Multiple Style Variations: Predefined layout and design variations to help you build accordion sections quickly.
  • Dynamic Content Support: Add text, images, and links inside accordion items for rich, flexible content areas.
  • Custom Styling Options: Control colors, backgrounds, and font sizes to match your website’s design.
  • Smooth Transition Animations: Clean open and close animations that improve readability and user experience.
  • Icon Support for Toggles: Select built-in icons or upload custom icons for expand and collapse actions.
  • Unlimited Accordions: Use as many accordion blocks as you need across posts and pages.
  • Fast and Lightweight: Optimized for performance with minimal impact on site speed.
  • No Coding Required: All settings are managed from the block sidebar – beginner-friendly by design.

Pro Version – Unlock Advanced Themes

B Accordion Pro extends the free version with advanced layouts and premium accordion designs.

Pro features include:

  • 5+ Premium Accordion Themes with modern, creative layouts.
  • Progress Timeline Theme – a visual timeline layout for step-by-step processes.
  • Geometric Bold Theme – sharp edges, bold borders, and interactive hover effects.
  • Vertical Timeline Theme – present chronological content such as milestones or project phases.
  • History Timeline Theme – a date-focused layout for historical events or company timelines.
  • Tabbed Accordion Theme – a hybrid layout combining tabs and accordions for large content sections.
  • Magnetic Accordion Block – a new accordion layout combining tabs and accordions for large content sections.
  • Circle Accordion Block – a new circle based accordion layout for large content sections.
  • Tabs Block – a new tabs layout combining tabs and accordions for large content sections.
  • Nested Accordion Block – a new nested accordion layout combining tabs and accordions for large content sections.
  • Priority Technical Support – faster access to developer support for assistance, fixes, and updates.

How to Use Accordion – Step-by-Step Guide

Getting started with B Accordion is quick and easy!

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open the page or post into WordPress block editor.
  3. Add the Accordion block from the Widgets block category.
  4. Configure content and styles from the block settings panel.
  5. Save or publish your page.

Enjoy your beautifully designed collapsible content!

Accordion Use Cases

FAQ Accordion

Create expandable FAQ sections that let visitors open individual questions without displaying every answer at once.
Use accordion layouts for product FAQs, service FAQs, support questions, documentation, and knowledge bases.

Documentation Accordion

Organize guides, instructions, help articles, and technical documentation into expandable sections.
This makes large documentation pages easier to scan and navigate.

Feature Accordion

Present product or service features in separate expandable panels.
Visitors can open individual features and read the details without scrolling through a long page.

Product Information Accordion

Organize specifications, features, benefits, and additional information into collapsible sections.

Project and Process Accordion

Break a project or workflow into individual expandable sections to explain different stages or steps.

Timeline Content

Use accordion layouts and Pro timeline themes to present milestones, project phases, company history, and chronological information.

Long-Form Content

Break large amounts of information into smaller expandable sections to make content easier to navigate and consume.

Who Can Use B Accordion?

B Accordion is useful for:

  • Bloggers
  • Website owners
  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Developers
  • SaaS businesses
  • Ecommerce websites
  • Documentation websites
  • Educational websites
  • Product and service businesses

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For ** Accordion**
  3. Click on the Accordion to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the ** B Accordion** plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the b-accordion.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the B Accordion plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
What is B Accordion?

B Accordion is a WordPress Gutenberg block plugin for creating responsive expandable and collapsible content sections.

Is B Accordion free?

Yes. B Accordion includes a free accordion block with multiple layouts, themes, styling options, responsive design, icons, animations, and other features.

Can I create an FAQ accordion in WordPress?

Yes. Add the Accordion block to your page, use each item title for a question, and place the answer inside the expandable content panel.

Can I create a horizontal accordion?

Yes. B Accordion supports both vertical and horizontal accordion layouts.

Can I create a vertical accordion?

Yes. You can create responsive vertical accordion sections directly from the WordPress Block Editor.

Does B Accordion work with Gutenberg?

Yes. B Accordion is designed for the WordPress Block Editor and provides a dedicated Gutenberg accordion block.

Can I add images and links inside accordion items?

Yes. Accordion items support text, images, and links.

Can I customize the accordion design?

Yes. You can customize colors, backgrounds, font sizes, icons, layouts, and other available styling options from the block settings.

Is the accordion responsive?

Yes. Accordion layouts are designed to adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.

Can I use multiple accordions on one page?

es. You can use multiple accordion blocks across the same page or website.

Does B Accordion support FAQ schema?

The plugin includes schema markup support for applicable accordion content.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. B Accordion Pro provides additional premium themes and blocks, including Steps, Magnetic Accordion, Circle Accordion, Tabs, and Nested Accordion.

Where can I get support?

You can post questions on the B Accordion support forum.
